description: Angular component for a color settings panel in a widget configuration UI, managing color types, gradients, ranges, and functions with form controls and event handling.

classes.name: ColorSettingsPanelComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing color settings in a widget, including form controls for color type, gradient, range, and function, with methods for copying, applying, and updating validators.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group with current color settings and sets up value change subscription to update validators.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on the selected color type.

methods.name: copyColorSettings
methods.description: Copies color settings from another component and updates the form.

methods.name: applyColorSettings
methods.description: Emits the current form values as the applied color settings.
